thesis: The tester forced the system to execute the full internal chain and exposed that the runtime failure was not prompt difficulty or timeout, but a broken inner Codex sandbox plus weak worker/control-plane/recovery contracts.
truthsExposed: The prompt was accepted and converted into runtime work.
The worker ran in the correct workspace.
The expected deliverable docs/advanced_programming_case_001.md was not created.
The inner Codex process returned code 0 while reporting a human/Markdown failure.

The old recovery logic retried/split instead of surfacing infrastructure failure.
The visible timeout belonged to the outer Prompt Flight monitor, not to the 900s task timeout.
